text_block_list.name: Matsuri
text_block_list.text: I sure didn't expect those monsters to fall out of the sky!
text_block_list.orig_text:
上から魔物が降ってくるなんて
びっくりしたッス！

text_block_list.name: Tomo
text_block_list.text:
...! Here come more!
How annoying... Now we can't get to the big guy.
text_block_list.orig_text:
！　
また来る！
まいったな、
本体に近づけないぞ……

text_block_list.name: Inori
text_block_list.text:
What a gigantic chicken!
Let's beat some sense into him!
text_block_list.orig_text:
とんだチキンヤローです！
根性叩きなおしてやるです！

text_block_list.name: Kaya
text_block_list.text:
Can you really talk, Inori...?
Oh well. The beating works for me!
text_block_list.orig_text:
それをイノリが言うか……？
まあいい、
このまま叩き潰すぜ！
